entry.prompt: Low-poly game asset for a top-down strategy game: a dwarf watchtower. One tall, thick, square stone tower, clearly taller than wide, with bronze-capped battlements, arrow slits and a crimson pennant on top.

style.suffix: Massive dark granite blocks, heavy bronze and iron fittings, carved geometric rune bands, squat and solid. Chunky low-poly shapes, hard edges, flat faces. Isolated building, no ground, no text, no characters.
style.texture: Stylized matte painted colours, even lighting, no baked shadows. Stone: dark warm granite (#5E5852) with paler carved edges (#8A827A). Metal: burnished bronze (#B07A3A) and dark iron (#3E3E40). Runes: faint warm gold (#C9A04A). Banners and cloth: saturated crimson red (#A0262A), no emblem. Small warm forge glow (#E8903A). No text or logos.
